ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Number: MON/WEL/LND/16/02/2023/03. Land Ministry Number: 4-3/4/2013/D/342. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for Uva Kuda Oya Commando Regiment Training School. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The allotment of land of approximately 2.0000 Hectares as described below as Lot No. 1, in inset No. 02, Sheet No. 4 of Cadestral Map No. 720266, prepared by the Superintendent of Surveys of Monaragala, situated in the Village of Kuda Oya in Ethiliwewa Grama Niladhari Division No. 150 J, Wellawaya Divisional Secretary's Division, Monaragala District, Uva Province: 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kalukanda; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Forest Conservation Department,

Mr. Arangwala Vakishta Arachchige Sirisena has been in possession with a license; Extent: 2.0000 Hectares. All persons interested in the aforesaid land is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Wellwaya on the 22nd day of May 2025 at 10.00 a.m. Further are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 30th day of April, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. K. K. Rൺඏංඇൽඋൺ Mൺඅൺඇං, Divisional Secretary, Wellawaya. At Divisional Secretariat, Wellawaya, On the 25th day of March 2025. EOG 03 - 0293
